Over the weeks my perspective on this game has changed with me finding out that Episode 5 is a rocky mess that shouldn't have SEEN 1.0 to the dev's rushing things because they wanted to please the fans to even the god horrible 1.0 marketing. reviews.review:
I first played this game when it came out in Early Access on Gamepass and it was pretty rough around the edges, after about a year it's now in a state I can definitely recommend to people.  It's basically Left 4 Dead in a space cruise ship, the aesthetic is 70s sci-fi, and the weapons are all very fun to use and have unique mechanics.

The core gameplay is generally go from A to B and survive, but that's where the similarities to Left 4 Dead end; you can find upgraded versions of your favorite guns scattered throughout the level, there's also special guns you can find which have limited ammo but do tons of fun and unique things.  There's health items and different grenade types scattered around as well, and you can use some environmental objects to setup traps for the hordes.

It's frankly the best Left 4 Dead type game since the original two and it's my go-to now for when I want this type of gameplay.  Unfortunately there's not a big player base, the game has sadly not been very well marketed or covered by the press/blogs.  It's also VERY 70s and if you don't like that aesthetic it's a bit off-putting.  There's not a ton of enemy variety, the special aliens are very similar to the special infected in L4D so not much new there either.

If all you want to do is hangout with some friends (or make new ones!) while playing a game this one is ideal for that, you can get into a pretty good flow-state and it's not a game that forces you to constantly pay attention and strategize since the difficulty seems to vary depending on how well you're doing.  This game is not interested in killing you and frustrating you, its goal is to be challenging enough because it ultimately wants you and your friends to have fun and succeed.

I got this game for free from one of the developers, but I'd like to think that didn't influence my opinion; it's not very innovative or the most fun I've had with a game, but it IS fun and a great way to pass the time and hangout with friends while you play something.
Retro-future-space Left 4 Dead co-op shooter is quite promising.
